messages:
Sofia: Quick question — ACME's private VPC invoice for Feb came back with a much larger cloud pass-through than we expected (egress + NAT + KMS). Also a separate line for 'license: GPU runtime' that looks like a per-GPU surcharge. Do we treat both as direct pass-through to the customer or roll into their monthly reserved charge?

Ajay: Short answer: egress and cloud provider charges = pass-through. License for our runtime is trickier; historically we amortize license across reserved capacity but for on-prem/VPC we sometimes surface it separately. Need the exact numbers to recommend.

Maria: Pulled numbers from billing export:
```
customer: ACME
period: 2026-02
cloud-egress: $18,430.12
cloud-nat: $3,210.45
kms: $412.33
gpu-hours (v100 equiv): 1,320 hrs
license-line (raw): $9,900.00
reserved-commit-discount: -$6,000.00
```
These were attributed to the customer ID via tagged project.

Devin: Customer is on an enterprise Private plan — they expected a stable monthly invoice. If we pass everything through they might see a +$22k swing. Can we smooth the license into the monthly fee and only pass through truly variable provider costs?

Ajay: We have two goals: accurate cost recovery and predictable billing. Proposal: 1) Pass-through true variable infra (egress/NAT/KMS), 2) Amortize runtime license across committed GPU hours (show as amortized license line), 3) include a small contingency line for unexpected spikes or deduct from reserved burst credit.

Sofia: Sounds reasonable. How do we define "true variable" vs amortized? Some infra (like KMS requests) scale with usage but are low-dollar — still variable.

Maria: Suggestion: thresholds — anything >$500/month per line item becomes explicit pass-through. Below that, fold into standard monthly reconciliation and call it "platform ops fee". That keeps invoices tidy.

Devin: Customer contract? It says 'customer will reimburse reasonable pass-through cloud costs.' They did not expect huge egress spikes. Can we show them the invoice breakdown and offer to amortize egress over next 3 months for churn protection?

Ajay: Contractually allowed. Two administrative asks: A) we need a standardized invoice template for Private that separates: (1) pass-through cloud lines, (2) amortized license, (3) reserved capacity discount, (4) support/SLA line, B) update billing code mapping so future exports tag these consistently.

billing-bot: [invoice snippet uploaded] (preview):
- Platform base (dedicated pool) $45,000.00
- License (amortized) $3,300.00
- Cloud pass-through: Egress $18,430.12, NAT $3,210.45, KMS $412.33
- Reserved commit discount -$6,000.00
- Total due: $64,352.90

Sofia: Thanks for the snippet. Two practical follow-ups: 1) For GAAP/recognition, do we record pass-through as revenue or contra-costs? 2) Do we need a customer-approved addendum to change smoothing/amortization?

Ajay: Accounting: pass-through that we bill at cost should be recorded net (no markup) where possible — revenue/contra depends on our ERP flow. I'll coordinate with accounting. On the addendum: yes — if we change invoice presentation or smoothing rules we need the customer's written acknowledgement. I can draft language.

Maria: Ops note: to avoid future surprises, let's add alerting when any single Private customer's daily egress > $1k or monthly > $10k so sales & finance get notified before invoice closes. I can add a billing webhook to the console.

Devin: I'll take ownership of customer comms — propose email explaining breakdown + offer three-month smoothing for the egress portion this cycle. Also include a one-page explainer on why license is shown amortized vs pass-through.

Sofia: Action items then: Ajay to draft addendum language and confirm accounting treatment; Maria to add billing alert + ensure tags are correct for next export; Devin to send customer comms and offer smoothing; billing-bot to regenerate invoice with amortized license line label. Ping here when done. :+1:

Ajay: Will draft addendum by EOD Wed and sync with accounting.

Maria: Billing alert PR opened (#gh-1427), ETA Fri. Also fixed tag mapping for kms/egress.

billing-bot: Regenerated preview invoice with amortized license label — new total unchanged until smoothing decided.

Devin: Email drafted, sending after Ajay's addendum looks good. Thanks all.
